hints.title: Minimum Enclosing Circle Definition
hints.text: The problem requires finding the minimum enclosing circle for a set of 2D points.

hints.title: Welzl Algorithm for Linear Expected Time
hints.text: welzls algorithm finds the minimum enclosing ball in O(N) expected time using randomized incremental construction.

hints.title: Circumcircle Boundary Solvers
hints.text: base cases handle 0, 1, 2, or 3 boundary points: 2 points form a diameter, and 3 points define a circumcircle.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Welzls randomized incremental construction achieves O(N) expected time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all triplets of boundary points takes O(N^4) operations, which times out for N = 3,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Welzls randomized incremental algorithm runs in expected O(N) linear time and O(N) recursion stack.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should demonstrate Welzls algorithm or circumcircle geometry for boundary sets of sizes 1, 2, and 3.
